typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

chatMemory.description: The chat memory (if it was generated)

searchQuery.description:
A {@link Genai.Query} object representing a user's search query.
Contains information about the query string and any filters applied to the query.

answer.description: The engine's answer to the query

engineLog.description: The log of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine} chain

failed.description:
Whether the result was a failure. If so, the reason for the failure is stored
in the #rationale and the Ui message in the #answer.

streamingState.description: If the result was streamed, tracks the state of the streaming.

usedTranslation.description: Whether the answer or some of its passages potentially used a translation service

translatorTypeName.description: The service used to translate answer if translation is enabled

project.description: The {@link Genai.Project} that will be used to execute the query.

userEmail.description: Information about the user that generated the query

passages.description: The (up to) 100 passages most relevant to the query according to {@link Genai.RetrieverActions#similaritySearch}

rationaleSources.description: The files were used as part of the #rationale to generate the #answer.

potentialRationaleSources.description:
All unstructured sources that were presented to the llm to generate the #answer.
This includes the #rationaleSources and other sources that were given to the llm but not used.

plan.description: The plan used to generate the result - {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic}.

sourceRelations.description:
Relation records that link this result to the sources that were used to generate it. There is a many-to-many
relationship, allowing sources to be used in multiple results and results to be generated from multiple sources.

chatHistory.description: The chat that the user had with the chat bot related to this original {@link Genai.Query.Result}.

intermediateResults.description: A field to store intermediate (i.e. while processing) portions of the overall result.

statusHistory.description: The history of interim statuses for the generation on the result

visualization.description: The visualization that best suits the structured data answer

steps.description: The steps performed to get to this result

configKey.description:
The hash of the configs that were being used in the application when this result was processed.
Generated using {@link Genai.ConfigUtil#generateConfigKey}

handlerUsed.description: The unstructured query handler used to initiate the query. Used primarily to handle streaming.

usedStructuredData.description: Whether structured data was used to answer the query

toolType.description: The type of tool used to generate the result

session.description: The {@link GenaiCore.Session.Kv} associated with this query

feedback.description: All the feedback given to the generative model result.

childResults.description: All child results (if any) for this result. See #parent

parent.description:
When a result is generated as only a step/part of generating another result, the inner/child results
will have this field populated with the result as part of which this one was generated.

toolId.description:
If this result was generated by a single tool as part of generating a #parent, this field will be
populated with the id of the tool.

allToolNames.description: The tools available to use when the result was generated

edited.description: Indicates whether the result has been edited by the user

conversation.description: The {@link Genai.Conversation} that this result is a part of.

getForUiResult.description: Calculated field for the UI result for this query

latency.description: Returns the time taken to generate the result in milliseconds.

parsedEngineLog.description: The parsed, JSON version of the #engineLog.

suggestedFollowUpQueries.description: Queries that can be a follow-up of the result, used for chatbot suggestions.
